tools.name: score_hook
tools.description: Score a TikTok, Reels, or Shorts hook against proven viral patterns. Returns a 0-100 score, percentile rank, matched pattern, strengths, weaknesses, and three improved hook variations. Use when the user has a draft hook to validate, wants to compare alternatives, or needs feedback before publishing.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_videos · Private data: brief_to_blueprint · Public sink: trend_pulse, predict_virality, brief_to_blueprint · Destructive: analyze_account, watch_account, get_changes, find_viral_template.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_videos · Private data: brief_to_blueprint · Public sink: trend_pulse, predict_virality, brief_to_blueprint · Destructive: analyze_account, watch_account, get_changes, find_viral_template

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "analyze_account" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
